Type: round reclaimed wood side table
Use: holding drinks, books or a lamp beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: rustic, farmhouse
Materials: reclaimed elm, natural weathered finish
Colors: warm light natural wood
Shape: thick round top, four curved hourglass legs, round ring base, chunky and compact, solid visual weight
Feel: warm, earthy, rustic
Goes with: linen, white walls, jute rugs, black iron accents; farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Rustic Reclaimed Elm Round Accent Side End Table, 16.9"W, Natural
product.description: Touches of modern and rustic intersect in this beautifully crafted side table. Uniform, reclaimed elm wood throughout the piece gives the appearance of being carved out of a single log. Its compact size makes it ideal for placing in tight spaces. 16.9"Diameter x 18.1"H Entire piece is made of reclaimed elm Modern design with a touch of rustic, thanks to reclaimed elm with an unfinished look A beautifully simple table compact enough to fit small spaces No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
